requirement.requirement_text: 业务用户通过网页表单提交一个主题。系统接收该主题后，交给语言模型生成 LinkedIn 帖子正文，并由语言模型同时生成一段用于生成配图的图像描述。随后系统对语言模型的输出进行清洗与规范化处理。系统再调用图像生成服务，依据上述图像描述生成一张配图。帖子正文被转换为适合 LinkedIn 展示的文本格式（由 Markdown 格式转换而来）。最后，系统将正文与配图一并发布到 LinkedIn 信息流，形成一条完整的帖子。

source_spans.text: Transform any topic into professional LinkedIn posts with AI-generated content and custom images! This workflow automates the entire process from topic input to published LinkedIn post, including professional image generation using Google's Imagen 4 API.
🤖 AI Content Generation: Uses Google Gemini to create engaging LinkedIn posts
🎨 Professional Image Creation: Automatically generates images using Google Imagen 4
📱 Direct LinkedIn Publishing: Posts content and images directly to your LinkedIn feed
🔄 Form-Based Input: Simple web form to submit topics
📝 Content Formatting: Converts markdown to LinkedIn-friendly format
📝 Form Submission: User submits a topic through a web form
🧠 AI Content Generation: Google Gemini creates post content and image prompt
🎯 Content Normalization: Cleans and formats the AI output
🖼️ Image Generation: Creates professional images using Google Imagen 4
📋 Content Curation: Converts markdown to LinkedIn format
🚀 Post Publishing: Publishes the complete post to LinkedIn

inputs: 业务用户通过网页表单提交的主题
allowed_actions: 调用语言模型生成 LinkedIn 帖子正文与配图用的图像描述
清洗并规范化语言模型的输出
调用图像生成服务依据图像描述生成一张配图
将帖子正文由 Markdown 转换为适合 LinkedIn 展示的文本格式
将正文与配图一并发布到 LinkedIn 信息流
visible_outcomes: LinkedIn 信息流中出现一条包含正文与配图的帖子
